verdict.rationale: The only security-relevant documentation is the Agent Skills spec's experimental `allowed-tools` frontmatter field for pre-approved tools, plus a note that skills can bundle scripts. A runtime probe shows `--list` lets you review a skill's instructions before installing. There is no documented trust model for third-party skills. On telemetry, community posts say the leaderboard is ranked by install counts collected through `npx skills`, and that this was not explained on the site. Missing for 10: a documented trust/vetting model for third-party skills, a telemetry and data-collection disclosure, documented execution or sandboxing boundaries for bundled scripts, and a non-experimental permission model.
